# Old Tyre — Poly Haven

Model and textures by **MP**, published at https://polyhaven.com/a/old_tyre.

Licensed **CC0 1.0 Universal**: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ . Poly Haven confirms commercial use, modification and redistribution at https://polyhaven.com/license. No attribution is required; credit is retained here for provenance.

Only model/texture assets are included. No website renders, logos or protected branding are redistributed.

Sources and publisher checksums are recorded in `sources.json`. A matching official 1K FBX and textures were retrieved because the uploaded 4K Blender ZIP exceeded the transfer limit. The runtime mesh is simplified and flattened for tyre stacks; its URP mask has zero metallic in RGB and inverse roughness in alpha.
